title.narrative: Technical assistance for increased agricultural production of smallholders in South Sudan

description.narrative: Contract related to: Technical assistance for increased agricultural production of smallholders in South Sudan - The South Sudan Rural Development Programme (SORUDEV) aims at improving food security in four States of South Sudan using a three pronged approach: (1) improving the States' food security policy implementation and strategic planning capacity, (2) increasing the agricultural production of rural smallholders and (3) facilitating the access of smallholders' agricultural production to markets
